CustomField.description: Lets the Retry action on an API issue, and the bulk retry, run a failed call again. This is not the automatic retry: that is governed by Max Retry Count and Retry Backoff. A re-run sends the request again.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Lets the Retry action on an API issue, and the bulk retry (Retry Selected on the API Issues list), send a failed outbound call again. Automatic retries are governed by Max Retry Count and Retry Backoff instead. Requires Log Issues.
CustomField.label: Retry Issues
